dialogues.speaker: Recording of Maintenance Worker Kotelnikov
dialogues.text: "...For the sake of His Majesty the Tsar's mercy, little one... make sure you record these words properly, and bring them to Grazina..."

dialogues.speaker: Recording of Maintenance Worker Kotelnikov
dialogues.text: "...Everything Morozov said was a lie... From the very beginning, he only meant to have us killed, so Rotwang's plan could move forward..."

dialogues.speaker: Recording of Maintenance Worker Kotelnikov
dialogues.text: "...I realized it too late... Do not let him find you, as he did me... Take the children and escape. The world outside has not been destroyed..."
